授業科目の概要.科目名称: 学術英語・アカデミックライティング
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、信頼できる情報リソースの強力な論拠とエビデンスによる論述実践を通したライティングスキルの向上を目的とする。教師や他の学生からのフィードバックに基づいて計画、執筆、再執筆を行うライティングプロセスを学ぶことで、将来の学術的および専門的なライティング作業に備える。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is designed to improve students’ writing skills by having them write a research essay featuring strong arguments and evidence from reliable sources. Students will learn a writing process involving planning, writing, and rewriting based on teacher and student feedback. This will prepare students for future academic and professional writing work.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度:
Active participation = 30%.
- This score includes appropriately following the guidelines and requirements set by the instructor during class activities.
- It also includes your level of preparedness for the class (e.g., completion of necessary homework/assignments before class).
Completion of free writing activities = 10%.
Free writing activities will be provided during most of the classes. Completing all free writing activities in class will yield the maximum score of 10%. No other criteria than completion are used for evaluation. Only completing the activity during the allocated time in class will count as completion.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: 注意: 生成AIは執筆の際に役立つツールとなりえます。しかし、生成AIはあくまで補助として使用し、代替ツールとして利用することは認められません。生成AIの言葉をコピーして自分が書いたふりをすることは、それが授業で直接許可されない限り、盗作（いわゆるカンニング）と見なされます。生成AIやその他類似のツールのコピーは、得点を失う原因となります。さらに深刻な場合、不合格となる可能性があります。授業によって、生成AIの使用時期や方法について他のルールを設定する場合があります。Notes: Generative AI can be a useful tool when writing. However, generative AI should only be used to help you, never to do work for you. Copying words from generative AI and pretending that you wrote them is considered to be plagiarism (a kind of cheating) unless your instructor directly says it is allowed. Copying from generative AI or any other place will cause you to lose points. If the problem is serious enough, you may fail the class. Your instructor may set other rules about when and how generative AI can be used.

head: 授業のテーマ
授業の内容（90分授業＝2時間）
事前/事後学修の内容
rows: Syllabus review. Introduction to assessment and Moodle course.
Introduction to essay structure and content. Practice writing mini-arguments.
Group work. Choosing a good topic. Preparing a good argument and thinking of possible main ideas. Preparing a rough outline. Formulating a thesis statement.
Introduction to the "waterfall" writing approach. Group discussion and peer review/feedback.
Group work. Preparing for the final essay.
Group work. Peer review of the essay outline. Writing the essay with the support of other classmates and the instructor.
Finish the first draft of body paragraphs 1,2,3.
Group work. Peer review of the body paragraphs. Writing the rest of the essay with the support of other classmates and the instructor.
Finish the introductory and concluding paragraphs.
Group work. Peer review of the introductory and concluding paragraphs. Writing the rest of the essay with the support of other classmates and the instructor.
Finish the first full draft of the essay.
Group work. Peer review of the first draft of the essay. Reiterating based on the feedback from other classmates and the instructor.
Finish the final draft of the essay.
Group work. Present your final essay to a group of students.
